response.sql:
WITH matched AS (
  SELECT ab.translink, t.tradekind
  FROM advancedbehavior AS ab
  JOIN transactionrecord AS tr ON tr.transreg = ab.translink
  JOIN trader AS t ON t.tradereg = tr.trdref
), counts AS (
  SELECT translink, tradekind, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
  FROM matched
  GROUP BY translink, tradekind
), shares AS (
  SELECT translink, tradekind, transaction_count,
         transaction_count::numeric / SUM(transaction_count) OVER () AS overall_share
  FROM counts
)
SELECT tradekind,
       AVG(transaction_count) AS average_count,
       AVG(overall_share) AS average_share
FROM shares
GROUP BY tradekind;

assumptions.assumption: “For each transaction and trader type” means count matched advanced-behaviour records per transaction and trader type; the share denominator is the total of those counts across all transaction/trader-type groups. Each transaction’s count is then equally weighted when averaging within trader type.
